exposure: marijuana use initiation age: never users, later initiators (≥16 years old), and earlier initiators
outcome: memory function as measured by the Wide Range Assessment of Memory and Learning (WRAML/WRAML2)
cohort: 119 urban, predominantly African American participants followed since birth
finding: While there were no significant differences in memory function between groups in childhood and adolescence, earlier initiation of marijuana use was associated with a decline in story memory from adolescence to young adulthood.
